n. a modern Russian triumvirate

troilite.definition:
n. Native iron protosulphide, FeS. It is known only in
   meteoric irons, and is usually in imbedded nodular masses of a bronze
   color.

troilus.definition:
n. A large, handsome American butterfly (Euph/ades, /
   Papilio, troilus). It is black, with yellow marginal spots on the front
   wings, and blue spots on the rear wings.
